notes: rme_J_ea0 is the absolute value of the reduced electric-dipole matrix element <n l J||D||n' l' J'> in units of e*a0, in the convention of the Safronova papers and the UDel portal (the same as ARC getReducedMatrixElementJ): symmetric in the two levels, A_ki = 2.02613e18 * S / (lambda_Angstrom^3 * (2J_k+1)) with S = rme^2. Steck's D-line sheets use <J||er||J'> smaller by sqrt(2J+1) of the lower level (factor sqrt(2) for the D lines); Steck values are given under rme_J_ea0.alternatives with that convention stated. Entries with method "theory" are relativistic all-order (linearized coupled-cluster) values from the Safronova group, taken from the UDel portal data service (https://atom.ece.udel.edu/graphql behind https://www1.udel.edu/atom/) or from the printed tables of Phys. Rev. A 83, 052508 (2011); the portal attaches no experimental reference to them. A_s and branching were computed by the portal from those matrix elements and NIST energies; they are "compilation" only where the underlying matrix element is experimental. Each level has one "lifetime" (experiment preferred) and, where sources differ, "lifetime_alternatives". Theory lifetimes are purely radiative (0 K); old experimental values for high levels may include blackbody and collisional depopulation. Lifetimes are isotope-independent at this precision; hyperfine constants are per isotope, taken from the recommended / weighted-average rows of Allegrini et al. 2022 (signs of D5/2 A constants as given there). ionization_energy is an extra top-level block. The 87Rb value of Mack et al. is measured from 5S1/2(F=1), which lies below the hyperfine centre of gravity. frequency_THz refers to 87Rb, frequency_THz_85 to 85Rb (hyperfine centres of gravity). Isotope shifts are nu(87) - nu(85).
